title: Exporting the six minute reference edit takes no longer than the edit itself
goal: A person exporting a long screen recording edit waits for it, and a tool that takes longer than the video to write it feels broken next to Final Cut. Make the 6 minute reference edit, with its transitions, titles and zooms, export at the sheet's default settings in at most six minutes on this Mac, with the same picture as today.
notes: Sixth success item of video-perf ('Export of the 6 minute reference edit takes at most its own length on this Mac'). Depends on a-speed-walk-measures-the-long-reference-edit-th. If the baseline already meets the bar, the guarded number in the short speed walk is the deliverable and the audit says so plainly. Competitors: Final Cut renders in the background and exports a cuts-only edit by passing frames through; that is an idea for later, not this task.
acceptance: Measured first: the speed walk's export time for the 6 minute reference edit at the export sheet's defaults, and a profile of the export saying where its time goes (decoding, compositing, encoding, waiting on the main thread). Numbers in the audit before any change.
The 6 minute reference edit exports in at most 6 minutes at the sheet's defaults on this Mac, measured three times, the slowest one counting; the 20 minute edit's time is recorded too.
What is drawn does not change: frames sampled at 20 moments (several mid-transition, one on a title, one in a zoom) differ from today's export by no more than a stated tolerance, measured.
The app stays usable while it exports: the longest main thread pass during the export is recorded and under 50 ms.
Walks that export video (the 1080p export walk, an-editing-session-walk) stay green; Scripts/test.sh passes; a perf note in the commit since the composite path is touched.
Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Speed walk baseline (2026-11-12, HEAD f12423c41 + the speed walk, probe, Next defaults): the 6 minute reference edit exported at the sheet's defaults (MP4, Standard, Full, whole video) took 1984 s, 5.5x the edit's length, 669 MB, route drawn. Measure it again with Scripts/perf/speed-walk.sh --long 6 (part three, Scripts/perf/walks/long-6-export.json, its own 90 minute clock); compare with Scripts/perf/compare.sh Scripts/perf/baselines/long-6.json <new>.
